answer: To blunt sybil floods, each new agent posts a bonded walnut of locked stake before its votes count, and that bond unlocks only after an oasis of quiet finality windows with no double-spend or identity churn. Peers keep a public mirror of each agent's attestation graph, so cloned identities that share the same outbound pattern get discounted together. Cheap clones then burn capital without buying influence, while honest sparse graphs keep earning.
